Generic ATX case-planning reference based on Intel's mechanical outline. This is a form-factor reference rather than an exact power-supply product.

Generic documentation reference, not manufacturer-certified fit geometry. The 140 mm reference depth is not a universal ATX PSU depth. Verify the selected PSU's actual body, mounting-hole locations, fan/grille projections, connector and switch layout, cable bend space, and ventilation before designing a printed case. No wattage, electrical conformity, exact SKU, price, or inventory stock is inferred.
